_about: The one file to edit when the brand changes. Run `python3 build.py` afterwards to regenerate the logo, tokens, icons and preview.
name: TEK TEK OY

roles._about: Which colour plays which part. Use the colour names above.

fonts._about: Logo letters are converted to outlines from the font file, so the logo looks the same on any computer.
fonts.body_family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

logo._about: The main logo is traced from the brand sketch by trace_logo.py. Its colour comes from roles.ink. To change the logo, redraw it and re-run trace_logo.py.

tagline._about: Small letter-spaced lines under the logo.
